## Cyrus boss and encounter designer Branch `feature/cyrus-r20-designers2` (from `feature/cyrus-r2`, 2026-10-10). MASTER-PLAN R3 "Gameplay Designers ... bosses". Extends "Cyrus gameplay designers (R3)" and "Cyrus menu and quest designers (R3)" with the same rules: a typed IR, hard caps, verified Java components, deterministic codegen, every number and text a config.yml setting, no arbitrary code. **Nothing is deployed or switched on**: it ships under the existing OFF flag `CYRUS_DESIGNER`; off, the router decides nothing and every request is byte-identical. **Not plan-gated** (owner decision for designers). Host seam: no new Nxeon imports, no table, no migration, no new asset kind (designs stay `CyrusProjectAsset` rows of kind `design`). ### 1. Files One design per file at `assets/designs/.json`; the top-level `kind` is `"boss"` (BossDesign) or `"encounter"` (EncounterDesign). Items, menus, quests, bosses and encounters share one id space. A mod may have only bosses. ItemDesign / MenuDesign / QuestDesign are unchanged (their JSON Schemas are byte-identical and every earlier golden hash still matches). | File | What | |---|---| | `lib/cyrus/designer/boss/spec.ts` | the IR (Zod): `BossDesignSchema`, `EncounterDesignSchema`, `BOSS_CAPS`, `BOSS_LIMITS`, `BOSS_BASES` / `MINION_BASES` / `ENTITY_CLASS`, `validateBoss`, `validateEncounter`, `crossCheckBosses`, `bossBudgetOf` | | `lib/cyrus/designer/boss.v1.schema.json` | the portable contract (generated by `scripts/cyrus/build-designer-artifacts.ts`) | | `lib/cyrus/designer/boss/java.ts`, `boss/components.ts` | the verified boss components (Java + metadata), the per-version `BossCompat`, `bossLibraryHash()` | | `lib/cyrus/designer/boss/compile.ts` | `bossParams` / `encounterParams` (every Param carries `ptr`, its place in the design), `bossClass` / `encounterClass`, README sections; used by `compileMod` | | `lib/cyrus/designer/boss/simulate.ts` | the TS twin: `BossFight`, `simulateEncounter`, `JRandom` (java.util.Random incl. `nextInt(bound)`), `javaShuffle`, `scaledHealth`, `damageMultiplier`, `bossCheckLines` | | `scripts/cyrus/boss-golden.ts` | golden record (`test/fixtures/cyrus-boss/golden.json`), `--print` review aid | | `test/cyrus-boss.test.ts`, `test/cyrus-boss-real.ts`, `test/fixtures/cyrus-boss/` | pure suite, node-2 runner, the showcase (3 items, 2 bosses, 1 encounter) + `broken_boss.json` + `jvm-check.json` | | `services/modbuilder/designer-boss-example.json` | the prompt example (a stray boss + a two-wave trial) | Changed: `lib/cyrus/designer/{compile,route,sync,service-entry}.ts`, `gameplay/{spec,compile,params}.ts`, `lib/cyrus/assets/{request,sync}.ts`, `lib/cyrus/meta.ts`, `lib/cyrus-mods/doc.ts`, `lib/modbuilder/{create,types}.ts`, `services/modbuilder/{server,prompts,designs,textures}.js` + `designer-spec.js` (regenerated) + `Dockerfile`, `scripts/cyrus/build-designer-artifacts.ts`, `test/{cyrus-gameplay,modbuilder-pipeline}.test.ts`. Also fixed in passing: an item class imported `.abilities.*` even when no design of the mod had an ability (javac: "package does not exist"); the import is now emitted only when the package exists (output unchanged for every earlier golden). ### 2. BossDesign `{ schemaVersion: 1, kind: "boss", id, name: {text, color?}, entity, stats: { health 20-1024, armor? 0-30, attackDamage? 0-40, speed? 0.1-0.5, knockbackResistance? 0-1, followRange? 16-64 }, equipment?: { mainHand|offHand|helmet|chestplate|leggings|boots: vanilla item or design item }, immune?: [fire, fall, drowning, projectile, explosion, suffocation, freeze, lightning], bossBar?: { color?, overlay?, showPhase?, darkenSky? }, arena: { radius 8-64, emptyDespawnSeconds 10-600, maxDurationSeconds? 60-3600, onTimeout?: despawn|enrage }, spawn?: { command? (default true), item?, cooldownSeconds? 0-86400, maxAlive? 1-3 }, phases: [1-5], attacks: [1-8], minions?: { maxAlive 1-16 }, scaling?: { healthPerPlayer? 0-1, damagePerPlayer? 0-0.5, maxPlayers? 1-20 }, difficulty?: { easy?, normal?, hard?: 0.25-3 }, drops?, messages?: { spawn?, defeat?, despawn?, enrage? } }`. - **Bases (closed)**: zombie, husk, drowned, skeleton, stray, wither_skeleton, bogged, piglin_brute, vindicator, pillager, ravager, iron_golem, blaze, spider, cave_spider, hoglin, zoglin, polar_bear, witch, breeze (each a Bukkit class literal in the generated code: no reflection). Minions / wave mobs: the same minus ravager, iron_golem, hoglin, polar_bear. Refused: anything that breaks blocks, explodes, teleports away, splits, flies or has its own boss fight (creeper, ghast, enderman, slime, wither, ender dragon, warden, ...). Neutral bases are warned: they fight only the target the boss gives them. - **Phase**: `{ id, name?, below, intervalTicks 20-400, attacks: [1-6 {attack, weight? 1-10}], onEnter?: [0-8 actions], selfEffects?: [0-3 helpful effects] }`. The first phase is `below: 1`, the next ones strictly lower; phases are ONE WAY (healing never goes back). onEnter targets every participant (nearest first, at most 8). - **Attack**: `{ id, name?, telegraph?: { ticks 0-60, particle?, sound?, text? }, cooldownTicks? 0-1200, targets: { select: nearest|random|farthest|all|self, max 1-8, range 1-48 (<= arena radius) }, actions: [1-12] }`. - **Actions (closed set)**, per target: `damage` (the boss is the source: armor, PvP rules and protection plugins apply), `knockback` / `pull`, `potion_effect`, `launch_projectile` (snowball / arrow / small fireball / wind charge from the boss's eyes; `damage` added on hit; removed after 5 s; arrows not pickable and with base damage 0; fireballs set no fire and break nothing), `spawn_particles` / `play_sound` (at the boss or each target), `send_message` / `actionbar` / `title` (to each target or the whole arena). Once per attack: `leap` (toward the first target), `summon` (minion class mobs next to the boss), `heal_self`, `self_effect` (helpful only), `delayed` (1-100 ticks, at most 2 deep; the targets are re-checked: alive and in the arena). No command, no block change, no explosion. - **Budget (static + runtime)**: the item library's `Budget` (64 actions, 32 entities, 512 particles, 3 projectiles, 8 tasks per attack; per-target actions count once per target) + 4 summons per attack. The validator proves the worst case; the runtime stops an attack that runs out. - **Drops**: `{ mode: participants|ground, minDamageShare? 0-0.5 (default 0.1), xp? 0-5000, items?: [0-8 {item, count 1-64, chance 0-1}], lootTable? }`. Participants mode: every player who did at least `minDamageShare` of the damage (direct hits and their projectiles) gets their own roll set into the inventory (overflow at their feet); nobody qualified (e.g. `/kill`) = nothing drops. Ground: one roll set at the boss. Items may be this mod's design items (with their identity). `lootTable`: only `:` of THIS project's data pack (the service checks the workspace's `assets/datapack` loot tables; a missing table at runtime logs and adds nothing). The base mob's loot, the equipment, minions and wave mobs never drop anything. ### 3. EncounterDesign `{ schemaVersion: 1, kind: "encounter", id, title (40), arena: { radius 8-64 }, start?: { command?, item?, cooldownSeconds? }, waves: [1-8 { delaySeconds? 0-120, spawns: [1-4 { entity (minion class), count 1-12 } | { boss, count 1 }], advance: cleared|timer, seconds? (timer: next wave; cleared: time limit), message? }], maxAlive 1-24 (every wave must fit), failure: { emptySeconds 10-600, timeLimitSeconds? 60-3600 }, rewards? (like drops), bossBar?, messages?: { start?, complete?, fail? } }`. Waves start after their delay; "cleared" advances when every mob of the wave is dead (bosses: defeated or despawned), "timer" after its seconds; the last wave cleared completes (rewards). Fails, with every mob removed and no rewards, when the arena is empty for `emptySeconds`, at the time limit, or when a "cleared" wave runs past its seconds. Rewards in participants mode go to the players with enough of the damage done to this encounter's mobs and bosses. ### 4. Runtime (the verified boss components) In `.designer` next to the item components (Gameplay's menu/quest library only when the mod also has menus or quests): `BossDef` (base of every generated boss; the scaling math), `BossCast` (one attack: boss, targets, multiplier, Budget), `BossEffects` (every action), `DropTable` (seeded rolls: one `nextDouble` per entry), `BossInstance`, `Bosses` (the hub), `EncounterDef`, `Encounters`, `BossCommand`, plus `BossCompat` (the only per-version file: GENERIC_ attribute names before 1.21.3). Generated: `bosses/Boss.java`, `encounters/Encounter.java` (straight-line calls; structure in the constructor, every value read in `load()`). - **One AI timer** (10 ticks) for every boss: validity (an unloaded boss ends the fight), leash (pulled back to its spawn point when it leaves the arena), participants (players in survival / adventure inside the arena), boss bar viewers (participants only; title = name + phase name when `showPhase`; progress = health), the mob's target (nearest participant; neutral bases need it), phase check, time out (despawn or enrage: damage x1.5, attacks twice as often), phase self effects (refreshed), and the next attack: a weighted pick (`Random.nextInt` over the summed weights) among the phase's attacks that are off cooldown and have a target, telegraph, then the actions with a fresh Budget. - **Spawning**: `World.spawn(location, .class, randomizeData false, init)` (no random gear, babies or jockeys; vanilla weapons are given explicitly: bow / crossbow / axe / sword per base), never persistent (`setPersistent(false)`: not saved with a chunk), not removed when far away, cannot pick items up, adult, immune to zombification, display equipment with drop chance 0 (a design item as gear is a copy WITHOUT its identity). Tags: PDC `:boss` / `:minion` / `:enc` + scoreboard tags `.boss`, `.boss.`, `.minion`, `.enc` (selectors work: `/kill @e[tag=.boss]`). Refused on peaceful difficulty, in an unloaded chunk, above the caps (4 live bosses, `maxAlive` per boss, the spawn cooldown). - **Never griefs**: our mobs never break or change blocks (EntityChangeBlockEvent cancelled), never burn in daylight (EntityCombustEvent without a block/entity cause cancelled), never convert (EntityTransformEvent cancelled), never hurt or target each other (friendly fire and targeting between our mobs and their projectiles cancelled); immunities by damage cause. - **Cleanup**: on defeat (drops, minions removed, bar hidden), despawn (no loot), chunk unload, `/ boss despawn`, disable (`cleanup: removed N bosses, M minions and K encounter mobs` in the log); leftovers of an earlier run (a crash) are removed on enable and whenever their chunk loads (EntitiesLoadEvent). Caps: 4 bosses, 48 minions, 2 encounters with 24 mobs each, plugin-wide. - **Commands** (wrapping the item / menu command): `/ boss list | status | check | spawn [ | spawn] | despawn | cast `, `/ encounter list | status | start [...] | stop ` (`.boss.admin`, operators); summon items need `.boss.summon` (everyone; right-click a boss's / encounter's design item, used up). `cast` runs one attack now without the telegraph; with no participant in range it targets the nearest other mobs (a testing aid). `check` prints the scaling math, drop / pick / shuffle samples computed on the server JVM (the TS twin prints the same lines). `reload` and `params` include bosses and encounters. - **Config**: `bosses..*` and `encounters..*` reset to the jar's values on a `config_version` bump (Bosses reads the on-disk version before the item loader migrates; the backup is the item loader's); a hand-edited phase threshold above the previous phase is forced down (a reload note). ### 5. Edit without regenerating Every number and text is a parameter: `bosses..name | stats.* | arena.radius | arena.empty_despawn_seconds | arena.max_duration_seconds | spawn.cooldown_seconds | spawn.max_alive | phases.

.name | below | interval_ticks | weights. | effects. | enter.a.* | attacks..name | cooldown_ticks | telegraph.ticks|text|sound | targets.max|range | a. (delayed children a.n.) | minions.max_alive | scaling.* | difficulty.easy|normal|hard | drops.min_damage_share|xp|d.count|d.chance | messages.*`; `encounters..title | arena.radius | start.cooldown_seconds | max_alive | failure.* | waves.w.delay_seconds|seconds|message|s.count | rewards.* | messages.*`. Each Param carries `ptr`, so `applyGameplayEdits` sets the value in the design (creating a missing object on the way, e.g. `spawn` for `spawn.cooldown_seconds`), checks it against its caps and re-validates the schema; `recompileModWithEdits` then changes config.yml (values, designer-values hash, config_version) and the README only. Structure (which actions, target modes, bases, immunities, bar style, wave entries) needs a normal build. ### 6. Build service, router, portal - **Router** (`route.ts`, with `CYRUS_DESIGNER=1`): boss words (boss, boss fight, mini-boss, raid / world boss, encounter, waves of mobs/zombies/..., wave defense/survival, arena fight, horde) route to the designer with `bosses: true`; "boss bar" alone is not a boss (that is the HUD); no boss route for ender dragon / wither fights, custom (animated) boss models, dungeons, PvP arenas, minigames, MythicMobs. A base build with boss / encounter rows keeps the part (`hasBossDesigns`, `existingBosses` from `create.ts`). Request: `service.bosses = true` only with `design`; meta `designer.bosses`. - **Service**: `assets.bosses` (boolean, needs `design`, else 400); the `BOSSES AND ENCOUNTERS` prompt part (bases, IR, actions, budget, checks, example) is appended after the designer sections only when `design && bosses` (prompt version `mb-design-2026-10-10.1+mb-boss-2026-10-10.1`, with `+mb-gameplay-…` in between when menus/quests are routed too); `checkWorkspaceDesigns` validates every kind with the regenerated bundle (per-kind caps 4 + 4); `assetKeysOf` also returns the data pack's loot tables; `compileWorkspaceDesigns` uses `compileMod` (`counts` gain `bosses` / `encounters`); the build event says "Compiled N item, N menu, N quest, N boss and N encounter designs". - **Portal**: `checkReturnedDesigns` re-validates and re-compiles every kind (`serviceAgreed` by hash); mime `application/vnd.nxeon.boss-design+json` / `…encounter-design+json`; `MbAssets.designs[].kind` gains boss / encounter; revision message "N bosses + N encounters"; NxLabs mod page: "Includes N bosses and M encounters; operators start them with the mod's boss and encounter commands (or a summon item where the mod says so)…". ### 7. Tests and real runs - RAN on devhost: `test/cyrus-boss.test.ts` (71: the showcase valid on every supported version, 26.3 fails closed, the kind discriminator; the JSON Schema current; 37 caps at min/max accepted and just outside refused + encounter caps; the deliberately broken boss rejected with 10 semantic codes and compileMod refusing the mod; code/commands refused; budget overruns (particles at every target, projectiles, nested delays, summons) and the exact worst case of a slam; forbidden bases / minions / harmful and invisibility effects; unreachable bosses and encounters, summon-item conflicts with menus, items with right-click abilities and other bosses, drop loops, foreign / missing loot tables; encounter wave caps, sources, boss counts, timer seconds, impossible time limits, too many bosses; every component present + documented, no menu/quest library in a boss-only mod; golden hashes on 1.21.1 / 1.21.4 / 1.21.8 / 1.21.11 / 26.1.2 / 26.2 and order independence; only Compat + BossCompat vary per version; generated code free of reflection, threads, network, commands, block changes, explosions; strict source rules + precheck clean on every version; the hardening in the component code; config.yml / plugin.yml / main class (boss-only and with menus); edits change config.yml only, a structural edit changes exactly the boss class; out-of-range edits refused; the simulator: the java.util.Random twin == the lines the REAL server printed (`jvm-check.json`), scaling, a two-player fight (one-way phases, telegraphs, cooldowns, drops by damage share), empty-arena despawn, enrage, the minion cap, the per-attack budget, encounter waves; TS == generated JS; prompt part + example + Dockerfile; routing; request + parseAssetsRequest; the service workspace (loot tables, kind caps, hash == TypeScript); portal sync; mod page). `test/modbuilder-pipeline.test.ts` +1 (a boss build through the fake CLI: the BOSSES AND ENCOUNTERS part, kind-aware results, the boss library in the jar, service hash == TypeScript, bosses without design = 400). `test/cyrus-gameplay.test.ts` updated for the two new mimes. - RAN REAL on node-2 (`devhost run --lock -- npx tsx test/cyrus-boss-real.ts --out …`; raw: `/root/agent-notes/cyrus-research/designers2-flights-2026-10-10.json`), showcase mod `BossTrials` (namespace `nx_r20boss1`): items ember_core (summon item), cinder_blade (display gear + a drop), trial_sigil (encounter start item); boss `ember_warden` (wither skeleton, 300 health, 3 phases Smoulder / Ashen Fury below 60% / Last Stand below 25%, attacks slam (telegraphed AoE damage + knockback), volley (random fireballs), cinders (2 blaze minions), leap (+ a delayed impact), participants drops, enrage after 10 min), boss `grave_lord` (zombie, ground drops, 10 s empty despawn) and encounter `ash_trial` (3 zombies + 2 skeletons until cleared, 4 husks on a 20 s timer, then the Grave Lord). FLIGHT_TABLE - **NOT RUN**: no real Minecraft client and no bot, so nothing a PLAYER does was exercised: being a participant (the boss bar on screen, targeted attacks hitting a player, projectiles hitting a player, damage shares from real hits, loot into a player's inventory, XP), summon items (right-click), the telegraph timing as seen by a player, vanilla melee / ranged AI against a player, protection plugins, sounds and particles as seen in game. The TS simulator covers the rules, not the game. javac not run for 1.21.1 / 1.21.4 / 1.21.8 / 26.1.2 (no resolved classpath on the build host; `javacVerified: false`). No real model build (fake CLI only): how well a real model writes boss designs is unmeasured. No customer server, no production DB, no migration, no deploy. ### 8. Decisions made here (the plan did not specify) - Bosses are vanilla mobs with plugin-driven attacks (no custom models; animated bosses are the creature pipeline's job). Closed base lists; the generated code uses class literals. - Attack patterns reuse the item graph's vocabulary and its Budget; new typed components only where a boss needs them (leap, summon, heal_self, self_effect, arena-wide texts). No branch/conditions inside boss attacks (phases + weights + cooldowns are the control flow). - Participants = players in survival/adventure inside the arena radius; the boss bar shows to them only; the arena is a radius (no walls: players can leave, the boss cannot). - Participants-mode loot needs at least 10% of the damage by default and nothing drops when nobody qualifies (no loot for `/kill`); minions and wave mobs never drop anything (no farming). - Bosses are never persistent: a chunk unload or a restart ends the fight (and leftovers are swept), so a boss can never be duplicated or saved half-dead. - Scaling: health once at spawn (players in the arena, 1..maxPlayers), attack damage at every attack; melee attack damage is set at spawn; difficulty multipliers default easy 0.75 / normal 1 / hard 1.25; peaceful refuses to spawn. - `cast` targets other mobs only when no participant is in range (a console testing aid, operators only). ### 9. Owner actions (nothing needed to merge) See OWNER-ACTIONS.md "Boss and encounter designer": `CYRUS_DESIGNER` stays off; image rebuild with `designer-boss-example.json`; a small paid eval of model-written bosses; a real-client test day (fight a boss with 1 and 3 players, summon items, loot shares, encounter waves, leaving the arena, a restart mid-fight).

function mainClassAll(pkg: string, main: string, ns: string, command: string, cls: { items: string[]; menus: string[]; quests: string[]; bosses: string[]; encounters: string[] }, ids: { items: string[]; menus: string[]; quests: string[]; bosses: string[]; encounters: string[] }, hooks: boolean, money: boolean, ms: MainStates | null): string {
  const gp = cls.menus.length + cls.quests.length > 0;
  const others = cls.items.length + cls.menus.length + cls.quests.length > 0;
  return [
    `package ${pkg};`, ``,
    `import java.util.List;`,
    ...(ms ? [`import java.util.Map;`, `import java.util.Set;`] : []),
    `import org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin;`,
    `import ${pkg}.designer.Bosses;`,
    `import ${pkg}.designer.Designer;`,
    ...(gp ? [`import ${pkg}.designer.Gameplay;`] : []),
    ...(ms ? [`import ${pkg}.designer.ModelStates;`] : []),
    ...(money ? [`import ${pkg}.designer.VaultMoney;`] : []),
    ...(cls.bosses.length ? [`import ${pkg}.bosses.*;`] : []),
    ...(cls.encounters.length ? [`import ${pkg}.encounters.*;`] : []),
    ...(cls.items.length ? [`import ${pkg}.items.*;`] : []),
    ...(cls.menus.length ? [`import ${pkg}.menus.*;`] : []),
    ...(cls.quests.length ? [`import ${pkg}.quests.*;`] : []),
    ``,
    `/** Main class. Generated by Cyrus from the designs (do not edit; custom code goes in the custom package). */`,
    `public class ${main} extends JavaPlugin {`,
    `    private Designer designer;`,
    ...(gp ? [`    private Gameplay gameplay;`] : []),
    `    private Bosses bosses;`,
    ...(ms ? [`    private ModelStates modelStates;`] : []),
    ``,
    `    @Override`,
    `    public void onEnable() {`,
    `        designer = new Designer(this, ${jstr(ns)});`,
    ...(gp ? [`        gameplay = new Gameplay(designer);`] : []),
    `        bosses = new Bosses(designer);`,
    `        designer.enable(${gp ? "null" : `getCommand(${jstr(command)})`}, List.of(${cls.items.map((c) => `new ${c}(designer)`).join(", ")}));`,
    ...(gp ? [`        gameplay.enable(getCommand(${jstr(command)}), List.of(${cls.menus.map((c) => `new ${c}(gameplay)`).join(", ")}), List.of(${cls.quests.map((c) => `new ${c}(gameplay)`).join(", ")}));`] : []),
    ...(money ? [`        if (getServer().getPluginManager().getPlugin("Vault") != null) gameplay.money(new VaultMoney());`] : []),
    `        bosses.enable(getCommand(${jstr(command)}), List.of(${cls.bosses.map((c) => `new ${c}(bosses)`).join(", ")}), List.of(${cls.encounters.map((c) => `new ${c}(bosses)`).join(", ")}), ${others}, ${gp});`,
    ...(ms ? [
      `        modelStates = new ModelStates(designer, List.of(${ms.rules.map((r) => `\n                ${r}`).join(",")}), Map.of(${ms.flagCounts.map(([k, n]) => `${jstr(k)}, ${n}`).join(", ")}), Set.of(${ms.aims.map(jstr).join(", ")}));`,
      `        modelStates.start();`,
    ] : []),
    ...(hooks ? [`        ${pkg}.custom.CustomHooks.enable(this);`] : []),
    `        getLogger().info(${jstr(`Designer ready: items ${ids.items.join(", ") || "-"}; menus ${ids.menus.join(", ") || "-"}; quests ${ids.quests.join(", ") || "-"}; bosses ${ids.bosses.join(", ") || "-"}; encounters ${ids.encounters.join(", ") || "-"}`)});`,
    `    }`,
    ``,
    `    @Override`,
    `    public void onDisable() {`,
    ...(hooks ? [`        ${pkg}.custom.CustomHooks.disable();`] : []),
    ...(ms ? [`        if (modelStates != null) modelStates.stop();`, `        modelStates = null;`] : []),
    `        if (bosses != null) bosses.disable();`,
    ...(gp ? [`        if (gameplay != null) gameplay.disable();`] : []),
    `        if (designer != null) designer.disable();`,
    `        bosses = null;`,
    ...(gp ? [`        gameplay = null;`] : []),
    `        designer = null;`,
    `    }`,
    `}`,
    ``,
  ].join("\n");
}

I'm sketching out the full set of HUD test cases: caps on glyph dimensions, text length, and sidebar lines; failure modes like broken codes, channel conflicts, too many HUDs or glyphs, unresolved references, and malformed ascent/pixel data; and the codepoint allocation logic, including whether duplicate codepoints across namespaces with the same home block should collide in detection even though their fonts are namespaced separately — I need to pin down which behavior the registry actually enforces here.

Now I'm planning coverage for font validation (dimensions, codepoint-to-slot matching, advance widths), pack building with fonts (path restrictions, fonts-only builds, mixed asset packs), and the compile step itself — ensuring HUD-only mods skip boss classes correctly, golden files match, and generated glyph constants line up with codepoints.

I also need to handle edit-without-regeneration (config-only changes), the simulator-vs-real-server parity test using a new preview fixture generated from TypeScript, and preview token edge cases like boss-source fractions in preview mode. On the service side I'm mapping out TS/JS parity, prompt and routing checks for HUD-specific words, asset request parsing, workspace caps, sync tamper detection, and whether the existing sync test harness already covers pack asset syncing so I can skip duplicating that work.

I'll skip full sync testing and just test buildPack and hudFont directly. Let me start writing it.

## Cyrus HUD and glyphs

Branch `feature/cyrus-r20-designers2` (2026-10-10), MASTER-PLAN R4 "glyph HUDs with honest limits (avoid core shaders)". A HUD is a design file (`"kind":"hud"`, same folder and id space as the other designs) compiled by the designer engine into the plugin, plus a font in the mod's resource pack. **Nothing is deployed or switched on**: it ships under the OFF flag `CYRUS_DESIGNER` (off = byte-identical requests); not plan-gated; no migration, no table, no new asset kind; host seam respected.

### 1. Honest limits (by construction)
A vanilla client with a server-pushed pack can only show TEXT in three places a server controls: the action bar line above the hotbar, boss bar titles and the scoreboard sidebar. A Cyrus HUD is glyph text there: small pixel-art glyphs in this mod's own font (`<ns>:hud`: one bitmap provider per glyph + one space provider for pixel offsets), bars made of glyph segments, values and plain text. **No core shaders, no free positioning, no widgets anywhere else on screen, no minimaps** (they need a client mod; the router says so instead of building one). The IR has no field for any of that (the schema has exactly three channels; tested).

### 2. Files
| File | What |
|---|---|
| `lib/cyrus/designer/hud/spec.ts` | the IR (Zod): `HudDesignSchema`, glyphs (15 Cyrus-authored presets tinted by a colour, or custom pixels + palette up to 16x16 / 8 colours, height 4-32, ascent -32..32 <= height), bars, parts, sources, show conditions; `validateHud`, `crossCheckHuds`, `allocateHudGlyphs`, `hudIdentRecords`, `glyphArt`, `glyphMetrics`, `partsWidth` |
| `lib/cyrus/designer/hud/font.ts` | `hudFont(huds, ns)`: the pack files (square RGBA PNG cell per glyph + `assets/<ns>/font/hud.json`), `checkHudFont` (re-checks the game's font rules) |
| `lib/cyrus/designer/hud/java.ts`, `hud/components.ts` | the verified HUD components: `HudDef`, `HudRender`, `HudSources`, `Huds` (hub), `HudCommand`, `HudBossSource` (only with bosses); `hudLibraryHash()` |
| `lib/cyrus/designer/hud/compile.ts` | `hudParams` (Param.ptr), `hudSources`, `hudClassWith` (generated `huds/<Id>Hud.java`), README section |
| `lib/cyrus/designer/hud/simulate.ts` | the TS render twin: `previewTokens`, `previewLine`, `hudCheckLines` |
| `lib/cyrus/designer/hud.v1.schema.json` | the portable contract (generated) |
| `lib/cyrus/textures/pack.ts` | `buildPack({ fonts })`: the font files ship in the mod's one pack (a HUD-only mod gets a pack too); only `assets/<ns>/font/*.json` and `assets/<ns>/textures/font/<dir>/*.png`, PNG-checked, 64 KB each, 64 files |
| `lib/cyrus/assets/sync.ts` | the portal sync builds the font from the re-validated HUD designs and passes it to the pack ("N HUDs" in the revision message; pack prompt "shows a HUD with custom icons") |
| `scripts/cyrus/hud-golden.ts`, `test/cyrus-hud.test.ts`, `test/cyrus-hud-real.ts`, `test/fixtures/cyrus-hud/` | golden record (+ the font), pure suite, node-2 runner, fixtures (`arc_staff`, `mana_hud`, `stats_hud`, `broken_hud`, `jvm-render.json`) |
| `services/modbuilder/designer-hud-example.json` | the prompt example |

### 3. HudDesign
`{ schemaVersion: 1, kind: "hud", id, glyphs: [0-24], bars?: [0-6 { id, source, segments 1-20, full, half?, empty, gap? -8..8 px }], actionbar?: { parts: [1-12], show? }, bossbar?: { parts: [1-12], progress?: source, color?, overlay?, show? }, sidebar?: { title: [1-4 parts], lines: [1-8 [1-8 parts]], show? }, updateTicks 10-40 }`.
- **Parts**: `text` (max 40, colour), `glyph`, `bar`, `value` (`int` | `percent` | `fraction`), `space` (-64..64 px, not 0: the space font, the only positioning a server has).
- **Sources**: `health`, `food`, `xp_level`, `air`, `ability_charges` / `ability_cooldown` of one of this mod's design items (a mana / ammo bar; the ability must have charges / a cooldown), `boss_health` of one of this mod's bosses (the nearest live one whose arena the player is in; empty otherwise).
- **Show**: `always` (default), `holding` a design item, `in_boss_arena` of a boss.
- **Checks**: glyph source (preset XOR pixels), rectangular pixels, palette keys, a visible pixel, ascent <= height, references (glyphs, bars, items + abilities with charges / cooldowns, bosses), at least one channel; across files: one action bar HUD and one sidebar HUD per mod (`channel_taken`), 2 HUDs, 32 glyphs and 16 space widths per mod, everything inside one 256-codepoint glyph block. Warnings: the shared action bar, the exclusive sidebar, a line wider than ~240 px, a boss bar without progress.

### 4. Glyph codepoints and the identifier registry
`allocateHudGlyphs(huds, ns)`: the project's home glyph block (`glyphBlockStart(glyphHomeBlock(ns))`, `lib/cyrus/engine-core/identifiers.ts`: 256-codepoint blocks in the supplementary Private Use Areas), glyphs in HUD-id then design order, then one codepoint per distinct space width. Deterministic from the designs + namespace, so the service compile (Java string constants via `Character.toChars`), the portal re-compile and the pack font agree without a database round trip. Because the font is the mod's OWN font (`<ns>:hud`, not `minecraft:default`), two mods can never draw over each other's glyphs even if their home blocks coincide; the conflict engine (`rp.font_codepoint`) keys codepoints by font file, so it sees no clash either. `hudIdentRecords` gives the `glyph` identifier records (`<ns>:<hud>_<glyph>` + codepoint) for `detectCollisions` / the registry. Note: the DB allocator `reserveIdentifier` (glyph kind) hands out globally unique codepoints; HUD glyphs are not reserved there (no DB in the build service), which is safe because of the own font.

### 5. Runtime (components)
- **Huds** (hub): ONE 10-tick timer; each HUD updates at its own rate (10-40 ticks) for every online player who has not turned it off. Action bar: re-sent every update (it fades after about 3 s; any other action bar message, e.g. another plugin's or an item ability's feedback, replaces it until the next update). Boss bar: one Adventure boss bar per player per HUD, shown while its condition holds, title = the rendered parts, progress = its source. Sidebar: a per-player scoreboard (`nx_hud` objective, `NumberFormat.blank()`, lines via `Score#customName`), ONLY for players still on the main scoreboard (another plugin's scoreboard is never replaced) and swapped back to the main board when hidden; unchanged lines are not re-sent. `/<mod> hud toggle` stores `<ns>:hud_off` in the player's PersistentDataContainer. Everything dropped on quit and disable. `huds.*` resets on a config_version bump like the other designers.
- **HudRender**: glyphs and spaces in the mod's font, drawn WHITE (a text colour would tint the art); text in the default font; bars = full segments, then one half segment when the rest is at least half, then empty ones; it also builds the token string (`[glyph] {px} 'text' <value>`) that the preview prints and the TS twin reproduces.
- **HudCommand** (wraps the mod command, after the boss command): `hud toggle` (players, `<ns>.hud.toggle`: everyone), `hud list | check | preview <id> <actionbar|bossbar|title|line<N>> <0-1>` (`<ns>.hud.admin`, operators; preview renders with every source at the fraction and prints the tokens + the component JSON); `reload` / `params` include HUDs.
- **Edit without regenerating**: `huds.<id>.update_ticks`, `huds.<id>.bars.<bar>.segments`, every text part (`actionbar.p<i>.text`, `bossbar.p<i>.text`, `sidebar.title.p<i>.text`, `sidebar.l<j>.p<i>.text`). Glyph art, sources, channels and bar style are structure.

### 6. Build service, router, portal
- **Router**: HUD words (hud, heads-up display, mana / stamina / energy / ammo bar or meter, ammo counter, cooldown display, action bar text, glyphs, scoreboard / sidebar HUD, boss bar title...) add `hud: true` to the designer route with an honest limits line. Client-only requests (minimap, waypoints on screen, shaders, free-form widgets, anywhere on the screen, keybinds, client mods) get NO HUD part and the notice "Free-form HUD widgets (...) need a client mod. A server can show glyph HUDs in the action bar, boss bars and the sidebar, which is what Cyrus builds." A base build with a HUD keeps the part (`hasHudDesigns`, `existingHud`).
- **Service**: `assets.hud` (needs `design`); the `HUD AND GLYPHS` prompt part (limits first, IR, presets, sources, example) only with `design && hud`; prompt version `…+mb-hud-2026-10-10.1`; kind cap 2; counts `huds`; the build event names HUD designs.
- **Portal**: re-validation / re-compile of `hud` designs, mime `application/vnd.nxeon.hud-design+json`, `MbAssets.designs[].kind = "hud"`, the pack font, NxLabs line "Includes a glyph HUD (icons, bars and values in the action bar, boss bars or the sidebar); players see it with the mod's resource pack and can turn it off with the mod's hud toggle command."

### 7. Tests and real runs
- RAN on devhost: `test/cyrus-hud.test.ts` (23: the showcase valid on every version; three channels only; the JSON Schema current; presets and metrics; caps (height, segments, update ticks, spaces incl. 0 refused, text length, glyph and line counts); the deliberately broken HUD rejected (ascent above height, preset + pixels, palette key, uneven rows, unknown glyph / bar / ability / boss) and compileMod refusing the mod; code / free positioning / shader fields refused; sources, conditions, channel_taken, too_many_huds, too_many_glyphs; honest warnings; codepoints in the home block, deterministic, order independent, no clash in `detectCollisions`; the font (9 bitmap providers, one space provider, square cells, ascent <= height, the re-check catches a broken ascent); buildPack with the font alone and with textures, foreign paths and non-PNGs refused; components present; a HUD-only mod has no boss library; golden hashes + the golden font on every version; boss mods without a HUD unchanged; glyph constants = the font's codepoints; strict scan + precheck clean; delivery rules in the component code; config.yml / plugin.yml / README; edits change config.yml only; the twin == the REAL server's lines (`jvm-render.json`); bar / value tokens; TS == generated JS; prompt part; routing incl. the minimap notice; request + parseAssetsRequest; service workspace; portal sync; mod page line).
- RAN REAL on node-2 (`devhost run --lock -- npx tsx test/cyrus-hud-real.ts --out …`; raw: `/root/agent-notes/cyrus-research/designers2-flights-2026-10-10.json` key `hud`): mod `HudTrials` (namespace `nx_r20hud01`) = the boss showcase + `arc_staff` (an ability with 5 charges and a cooldown) + `mana_hud` (action bar: heart, health value, a 5-segment mana bar from the staff's charges with half segments and -1 px gaps, " Mana"; boss bar while in the Ember Warden's arena: skull + name + the boss's health %) + `stats_hud` (sidebar: coin title, food x/20, XP level, an air bar).

HUD_FLIGHT_TABLE

- **NOT RUN / not verified**: no real client, so nothing a player SEES was checked: whether the font loads and the glyphs look right, alignment and ascent, the space font offsets, glyph shadows, the action bar timing against other messages, the boss bar and the sidebar on screen, live values (charges, cooldowns, a boss's health) while playing, `hud toggle` by a player, supplementary-plane codepoints in a real client (they are valid font codepoints, but no client loaded this pack). The pack itself was built and re-checked offline (`checkHudFont`) but never sent to a client. javac only on 1.21.11 and 26.2. No real model build. No deploy.

### 8. Decisions made here
- HUDs are designs in the designer engine (not a new asset kind); glyphs are Cyrus-authored presets or small inline pixel grids (no image upload path); one action bar and one sidebar HUD per mod; no quest-progress source yet (the quest store has no per-objective fraction API); no `armor` source (no per-version attribute constant in the item Compat).
- The font is the mod's own (`<ns>:hud`), so codepoints never clash in game; codepoints are computed from the namespace's home block (not reserved in the DB).
- The sidebar never replaces another plugin's scoreboard; the action bar is best effort (honest note in the README and the warnings).

### 9. Owner actions
See OWNER-ACTIONS.md "HUD and glyphs".

content.content:
## Cyrus playtest bots

Branch `feature/cyrus-r19-verify` (2026-10-10, MASTER-PLAN R3 "Playtest scripts", 4.6 "Mineflayer scenario bots"). **Not wired into the build path or the gate sweep; nothing deployed; no migration.** New OFF flag `CYRUS_PLAYTEST` (used by `runPlaytest`; a by-hand real run passes `enabled: true`).

**What it does.** A ModSpec's acceptance tests (`tests[]`, kind `functional`) are compiled into a typed PLAYTEST PLAN; ONE Test Flight on node-2 boots the real Paper server with the build's jar, runs the normal boot checks, then a scripted Mineflayer player (`NxPlaytest`, offline mode, loopback inside the flight's private netns) joins and runs one scenario per acceptance test. The flight gets a seventh check, `playtest` (required whenever a plan is attached), and the report carries the bot's per-scenario, per-step result with evidence.

**Files**
- `lib/cyrus/playtest/plan.ts`: the plan schema + `validatePlaytestPlan` (no free-form code: 14 step kinds), `PLAYTEST_BOT_VERSIONS` (versions the bot was RUN against), `playtestVersion`.
- `lib/cyrus/playtest/generate.ts`: `planFromSpec(spec, { scripts?, op? })` and `compileCriterion(text)`, the deterministic criteria compiler (no model call). Coverage per test: `explicit` (typed steps given by the author/designer, validated), `scripted` (compiled from the description), `not_scriptable` (with the reason), `manual`, `other_check` (compile/scan/boot are proven elsewhere).
- `lib/cyrus/playtest/verdict.ts`: `playtestVerdict(plan, report, coverage)`: per scenario pass/fail/not_run + reason, per requirement passed/failed/not_run/not_scripted/manual/other_check, and the label `Playtested on Paper <v>: N of M acceptance checks passed[, F failed][, R not run]`.
- `lib/cyrus/playtest/flight.ts`: `runPlaytest(spec, flight, runner)` (flag, version must equal the spec target and be in the bot list), `withPlaytest` (raises the flight time budget).
- `services/modbuilder/tools/testflight/playtest-lib.js` (pure, shared by runner + bot + tests), `bot.js` (the bot process), `bot/package.json` + `bot/package-lock.json` (mineflayer **4.39.0** pinned with 91 integrity hashes), runner `tf-lite-4` (`ensureBot`, `stagePlaytest`). `lib/cyrus/testflight/client.ts` `RUNNER_FILES` now pushes these too.
- Fixtures: `fixtures/play` (TfPlay: join message, `/tfgem` named diamond, `/tfboost` speed + title, `/tfup` teleport, right-click the gem) and `fixtures/play-broken` (identical except `/tfgem` gives DIRT), `test/fixtures/cyrus-playtest/tfplay.modspec.json` (8 tests: 6 functional, 1 boot, 1 manual).
- Tests: `test/cyrus-playtest.test.ts` (17: compiler, TS/JS validator parity on 14 bad plans, spec wiring, verdict honesty, `bot.js` against a FAKE mineflayer for the good/broken/kick cases), `test/cyrus-playtest-real.ts` (by hand on node-2).

**Criteria grammar** (what a functional test description may say; the AI author prompt should use it): triggers `when a player joins`, running `` `/cmd args` `` (or a bare `/cmd`), the console runs `` `cmd` ``, holding `` `item_id` `` ... right-clicking, waits N ms/seconds; outcomes says/replies/sees/shows/tells/message "text", never/not ... "text", title "text", gives/receives/has [N | a] `` `item` `` | N item [named "Name"] (lists with "and"), never gives ..., the `` `speed` `` effect, teleports/moves N blocks; "as an operator" makes the bot op (ops.json before boot). A quoted text that no outcome claims is reported as a problem, never silently checked or dropped.

**Step kinds**: join, command, chat, server (RCON, `{bot}` = the bot name, optional `expect` on the reply), wait (max 10 s), hold, use_item, expect_chat, expect_no_chat, expect_inventory (count = at least, name = custom-name substring), expect_no_item, expect_effect, expect_title, expect_moved. Limits: 16 scenarios x 24 steps, 90 s budget (max 180), join 30 s. Reserved, never sent by a playtest (player or console): stop, restart, reload, op, deop, kick, ban(-ip), pardon(-ip), whitelist, save-off, save-all. Each scenario starts with `clear <bot>` + `effect clear <bot>` (reset) unless `reset: false`.

**Honesty rules**: a scenario passes only if the bot joined, every step ran and passed with evidence, and the server logged no error matcher hit while it ran (an exception in a command handler fails the scenario even if the chat looked right); steps after a failure are `not_run`; a requirement is passed only if a covering scenario passed and none failed; a version without a verified bot is refused at the spec (`no verified playtest bot for Minecraft <v>`), never "skipped = ok"; a bot that cannot install/start/join is `not_run` (flight `incomplete`), a kick at join is `fail` with the reason.

**Safety on node-2**: the bot runs inside the flight's private network namespace (it can only reach 127.0.0.1: the test server and its RCON), as uid 65534 with no_new_privs, nice 10, `--max-old-space-size=256`, a hard timeout (budget + 20 s, exact-PID kill after re-checking the run marker, which is also on the bot's cmdline so the leak scan covers it). Mineflayer is installed ONCE per lockfile with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` (integrity-checked) into `/tank/nxeon-build/tmp/testflight/bot/<lock sha256>/` (126 MB incl. npm cache; root-owned, read-only to the bot), on the host network while the flight lock is held, like the JDK/Paper downloads. The Mineflayer code never runs in the app or the worker.

**Real runs (RAN on node-2, 2026-10-10; raw: `/root/agent-notes/cyrus-research/verify-flights-2026-10-10.json` key `playtest`)**, Paper 1.21.11 b132, JDK 21, mineflayer 4.39.0 / minecraft-protocol 1.68.0, plan compiled from `tfplay.modspec.json` (6 scenarios, 17 steps):
- TfPlay (good): flight **passed**, all 7 checks; playtest 6 of 6 (T-1 join message 0.9 s, T-2 named diamond + reply, T-3 speed effect + "BOOST" title + reply, T-4 moved >= 5 blocks, T-5 hold diamond + right-click -> "The Cyrus Gem glows", T-6 never replies "error"). Bot join 1.7 s; whole flight 34.5 s (boot 17.5 s, 924 MB peak RSS; the playtest adds about 13 s). First run installed the bot in 2.9 s.
- TfPlayBroken (`/tfgem` gives dirt): boot checks ALL pass (it loads, enables, registers commands: a boot test alone would call it fine); playtest **failed** 4 of 6: T-2 at `expect_inventory` ("LACKS 1x diamond named "Cyrus Gem" ... inventory: 1x dirt "Cyrus Gem""), T-5 at `hold` ("no diamond in the inventory"); the others pass. Flight `failed`. Whole flight 33.5 s, 896 MB.
- First attempt (kept for honesty): the bot dir was created 0700 by `mkdtemp`, so the bot (uid 65534) could not read Mineflayer; both flights reported the playtest `not_run` (good flight `incomplete`, never passed). Fixed (`chmod 755`) and re-run as above. The broken fixture's first plugin.yml had a YAML error (a colon in the description), which Paper 1.21.11 logs as `[DirectoryProviderSource] Error loading plugin: Invalid plugin.yml` (used by the Server Doctor).

**NOT RUN / not covered**: only Minecraft 1.21.11 is verified (mineflayer 4.39.0 lists up to 26.1; 26.1.2/26.2 were not flown, so they are refused); not wired into the Test Flight gate sweep or the build path (needs the build's stored ModSpec + a decision on billing/time per build); no model writes the criteria yet (the compiler handles the grammar above; anything else is `not_scriptable`); GUI menus, block placing/breaking, combat, mobs, resource packs (the bot does not load packs) and multi-player scenarios are not step kinds yet; one bot per flight.

**Owner actions**: see OWNER-ACTIONS.md "Verification + health bundle". Decide whether a failed playtest may block install/publish (like `CYRUS_TESTFLIGHT_BLOCK_ON_FAIL`), whether customers see the per-requirement table, and the time budget per build.

Actually the leap attack applies slowness after a delay, which is a potion effect mineflayer can detect via entity_effect packets even though resistance doesn't block it. So I'll rework T-3 to cast leap and then expect_effect "slowness" within 3000ms, keep the slam's "on 1 target" server reply check, drop the expect_moved assertion, and make sure reset:false stays off for effects clearing.

For T-4, I'm wondering if the HUD action bar message isn't being captured because messagestr doesn't fire for actionbar-type messages.

Checking mineflayer's internals, action bar packets (sent as system_chat with overlay/positionId 2) emit an 'actionBar' event rather than the regular 'message' event, so anything listening only for messagestr would miss it entirely — meaning the playtest bot's HUD check is probably just listening to the wrong event.

# Q: Designers part 2 (boss + encounter designer, HUD and glyphs), 2026-10-10

Branch `feature/cyrus-r20-designers2` (worktree `/tank/dev-worktrees/cyrus-r20`), from `feature/cyrus-r2`, latest r2 merged in (clean). Commits: `91d39e2922` bosses, `0338e587fd` HUD, merge, then a follow-up (HUD live preview, the scripted-player flight, docs). Nothing deployed, merged to main, migrated or switched on; `CYRUS_DESIGNER` stays off. Docs: "Cyrus boss and encounter designer", "Cyrus HUD and glyphs". Owner sections appended to OWNER-ACTIONS.md. Raw flights: `designers2-flights-2026-10-10.json` (keys `boss`, `hud`, `playtest`).

## 1. Boss and encounter designer (DONE)
- IR on the existing design files (`"kind":"boss"` / `"encounter"`; item, menu, quest designs and their goldens unchanged): closed list of 20 vanilla bases, 1-5 one-way phases by health (onEnter actions, self buffs), up to 8 telegraphed attacks built from the existing action vocabulary under the item library's Budget (+ new typed actions leap, summon, heal_self, self_effect, arena-wide texts), arena (leash, participants, empty-arena despawn, time out / enrage), boss bar, capped minions, player-count and difficulty scaling, drops by damage share (vanilla items, design items, the project's data pack loot tables), wave encounters with rewards.
- Verified components: Bosses hub (ONE 10-tick AI timer), BossEffects, DropTable, Encounters, BossCommand, per-version BossCompat. Never persistent, never griefs / burns / converts / hurts each other, leftovers swept; caps 4 bosses, 48 minions, 2 encounters x 24 mobs.
- Every number / text is a config.yml setting; edits change config.yml only (Param.ptr). TS simulator incl. a java.util.Random twin. Router words, prompt part, service + portal kind-aware, mod page line, bundle + `boss.v1.schema.json` regenerated.

## 2. HUD and glyphs (DONE)
- `"kind":"hud"` designs: glyphs (15 Cyrus presets tinted, or small pixel grids), bars from glyph segments, values (health, food, XP, air, ability charges / cooldown, a boss's health), conditions; delivered only in the action bar, per-player boss bars and a per-player sidebar (never replacing another plugin's scoreboard). No shaders / free positioning / widgets; minimap-style requests get a "needs a client mod" notice.
- The mod's own font `<ns>:hud` (bitmap cells + space font), codepoints from the project's home glyph block (engine-core identifiers); the pack builder ships it, the portal sync builds it. Live preview command for any online player.

## 3. RAN
- Unit: `cyrus-boss` 71, `cyrus-hud` 23, pipeline +1; the Cyrus + builder suite after the r2 merge: SUITE_LINE; tsc clean; all artifacts current.
- javac 0 warnings + strict scan clean + reproducible jars on Paper 1.21.11 (JDK 21) and 26.2 (JDK 25), both items.
- Boss Test Flight, both lanes: 55 RCON + 2 log checks passed: spawn refusals (peaceful, unloaded), definitions, the RNG / scaling twin identical on the JVM, phases by /damage, a test-target slam measured on a villager (20 -> 15.5 health), minion cap 4, leash, defeat with no loot for /kill, ground drops, empty despawn, the full Ash Trial (waves by kill and timer, boss wave, completion), clamping, migration, cleanup on stop; the edit jar differs only in config.yml.
- HUD Test Flight, both lanes: 22 RCON checks: codepoints from the Java strings == TS == the emitted font; 8 rendered channels identical to the TS twin; clamping, migration, the command chain; edit jar config-only.
- A scripted Mineflayer player (Paper 1.21.11 only): 5 of 5 scenarios: summon item spawns the boss, the bot is a participant and gets the spawn message and phase title, slam + leap hit it as a real target (slowness applied; the wither skeleton's own melee too), its killing blow puts the loot in its inventory; the HUD reads its live values (staff charges 5 -> 4 after a real right-click, the live boss's health %).
- The deliberately broken boss (10 codes) and broken HUD (9 errors) are rejected; no jar.

## 4. NOT RUN / not verified
- No real Minecraft client: nothing was SEEN (font loading, glyph alignment, boss bar / sidebar / action bar on screen, particles, sounds). The bot does not load packs and records chat and titles only.
- Knockback on a client (Mineflayer did not move), projectiles hitting a player, several players, XP, protection plugins, a player on 26.2 (no verified bot).
- javac only on 1.21.11 and 26.2 (others compile per API sheets, `javacVerified: false`).
- No paid model build: the prompt parts and validators are unit-tested only.

## 5. Found and fixed in passing
- Item classes imported `<pkg>.abilities.*` even when no design had an ability (javac failure for ability-less mods); now only when the package exists (no golden changed).

## 6. Owner decisions (details in OWNER-ACTIONS.md)
Loot only for >= 10% damage share (none for /kill); bosses never persistent (a restart ends the fight); difficulty multipliers 0.75 / 1 / 1.25; HUD glyph codepoints are derived from the home block, not reserved in `CyrusIdentifier` (safe: own font); the image rebuild must include `designer-boss-example.json` + `designer-hud-example.json`; a real-client test day; a small paid eval.
